items.text:
अतिमानादतिक्रोधात्स्नेहाद्वा यदि वा भयात् ।
उद्बध्नीयात्स्त्री पुमान्वा गतिरेषा विधीयते ॥ ४.१ ॥
items.tr:
atimānādatikrodhātsnehādvā yadi vā bhayāt |
udbadhnīyātstrī pumānvā gatireṣā vidhīyate || 4.1 ||
items.en: If a woman or a man hangs themselves out of too much pride, too much anger, attachment, or fear, this is their fate:

items.text:
पूयशोणितसंपूर्णे त्वन्धे तमसि मज्जति ।
षष्ठीर्वर्षसहस्राणि नरकं प्रतिपद्यते ॥ ४.२ ॥
items.tr:
pūyaśoṇitasaṃpūrṇe tvandhe tamasi majjati |
ṣaṣṭhīrvarṣasahasrāṇi narakaṃ pratipadyate || 4.2 ||
items.en: … they sink into blind darkness full of pus and blood, and stay in hell for sixty thousand years.

items.text:
नाशौचं नोदकं नाग्निं नाश्रुपातं च कारयेत् ।
वोढारोऽग्निप्रदातारः पाशच्छेदकरास्तथा ॥ ४.३ ॥
items.tr:
nāśaucaṃ nodakaṃ nāgniṃ nāśrupātaṃ ca kārayet |
voḍhāro'gnipradātāraḥ pāśacchedakarāstathā || 4.3 ||
items.en: No impurity, no water offering, no cremation and no shedding of tears should be done for them. Those who carry the body, those who light the fire, and those who cut the rope

items.text:
तप्तकृच्छ्रेण शुध्यन्तीत्येवं आह प्रजापतिः ।
गोभिर्हतं तथोद्बद्धं ब्राह्मणेन तु घातितं ॥ ४.४ ॥
items.tr:
taptakṛcchreṇa śudhyantītyevaṃ āha prajāpatiḥ |
gobhirhataṃ tathodbaddhaṃ brāhmaṇena tu ghātitaṃ || 4.4 ||
items.en: … become pure by the Taptakṛcchra; so said Prajāpati. One killed by cows, one who hanged himself, and one killed by a brāhmaṇa:
items.note: Taptakṛcchra: the 'hot Kṛcchra' penance of drinking only hot water, hot milk and hot ghee, then fasting (described in 4.7–4.8).

items.text:
संस्पृशन्ति तु ये विप्रा वोढारश्चाग्निदाश्च ये ।
अन्ये ये वानुगन्तारः पाशच्छेदकराश्च ये ॥ ४.५ ॥
items.tr:
saṃspṛśanti tu ye viprā voḍhāraścāgnidāśca ye |
anye ye vānugantāraḥ pāśacchedakarāśca ye || 4.5 ||
items.en: … the brāhmaṇas who touch such bodies, who carry them, who light the fire, the others who follow, and those who cut the rope

items.text:
तप्तकृच्छ्रेण शुद्धास्ते कुर्युर्ब्राह्मणभोजनम् ।
अनडुत्सहितां गां च दद्युर्विप्राय दक्षिणाम् ॥ ४.६ ॥
items.tr:
taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhāste kuryurbrāhmaṇabhojanam |
anaḍutsahitāṃ gāṃ ca dadyurviprāya dakṣiṇām || 4.6 ||
items.en: … become pure by the Taptakṛcchra; then they should feed brāhmaṇas and give a cow with a bull to a brāhmaṇa as dakṣiṇā.
items.note: dakṣiṇā: the fee or gift given to a priest or brāhmaṇa after a rite.

items.text:
त्र्यहं उष्णं पिबेद्वारि त्र्यहं उष्णं पयः पिबेत् ।
त्र्यहं उष्णं पिबेत्सर्पिर्वायुभक्षो दिनत्रयं ॥ ४.७ ॥
items.tr:
tryahaṃ uṣṇaṃ pibedvāri tryahaṃ uṣṇaṃ payaḥ pibet |
tryahaṃ uṣṇaṃ pibetsarpirvāyubhakṣo dinatrayaṃ || 4.7 ||
items.en: For three days he should drink hot water, for three days hot milk, for three days hot ghee, and for three days live on air.

items.text:
षट्पलं तु पिबेदम्भस्त्रिपलं तु पयः पिबेत् ।
पलं एकं पिबेत्सर्पिस्तप्तकृच्छ्रं विधीयते ॥ ४.८ ॥
items.tr:
ṣaṭpalaṃ tu pibedambhastripalaṃ tu payaḥ pibet |
palaṃ ekaṃ pibetsarpistaptakṛcchraṃ vidhīyate || 4.8 ||
items.en: He should drink six palas of water, three palas of milk and one pala of ghee. This is the Taptakṛcchra.
items.note: pala: a unit of weight, roughly 40–50 grams.

items.text:
यो वै समाचरेद्विप्रः पतितादिष्वकामतः ।
पञ्चाहं वा दशाहं वा द्वादशाहं अथापि वा ॥ ४.९ ॥
items.tr:
yo vai samācaredvipraḥ patitādiṣvakāmataḥ |
pañcāhaṃ vā daśāhaṃ vā dvādaśāhaṃ athāpi vā || 4.9 ||
items.en: A brāhmaṇa who unknowingly lives with fallen people and the like for five days, ten days or twelve days,

items.text:
मासार्धं मासं एकं वा मासद्वयं अथापि वा ।
अब्दार्धं अब्दं एकं वा तदूर्ध्वं चैव तत्समः ॥ ४.१० ॥
items.tr:
māsārdhaṃ māsaṃ ekaṃ vā māsadvayaṃ athāpi vā |
abdārdhaṃ abdaṃ ekaṃ vā tadūrdhvaṃ caiva tatsamaḥ || 4.10 ||
items.en: … for half a month, one month or two months, for half a year, one year or longer, becomes equal to them (in sin).

items.text:
त्रिरात्रं प्रथमे पक्षे द्वितीये कृच्छ्रं आचरेत् ।
तृतीये चैव पक्षे तु कृच्छ्रं सांतपनं चरेत् ॥ ४.११ ॥
items.tr:
trirātraṃ prathame pakṣe dvitīye kṛcchraṃ ācaret |
tṛtīye caiva pakṣe tu kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ caret || 4.11 ||
items.en: In the first case he should fast for three nights; in the second, do a Kṛcchra; in the third, the Sāntapana Kṛcchra;
items.note: Kṛcchra (Prājāpatya): a 12-day penance of graded eating and fasting. Sāntapana: a short penance living only on pañcagavya and kuśa-grass water, then fasting.

items.text:
चतुर्थे दशरात्रं स्यात्पराकः पञ्चमे मतः ।
कुर्याच्चान्द्रायणं षष्ठे सप्तमे त्वैन्दवद्वयम् ॥ ४.१२ ॥
items.tr:
caturthe daśarātraṃ syātparākaḥ pañcame mataḥ |
kuryāccāndrāyaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhe saptame tvaindavadvayam || 4.12 ||
items.en: … in the fourth, a ten-night fast; in the fifth, the Parāka; in the sixth, the Cāndrāyaṇa; and in the seventh, two Aindava penances;
items.note: Parāka: a twelve-day total fast. Aindava: another name for the Cāndrāyaṇa.

items.text:
शुद्ध्यर्थं अष्टमे चैव षण् मासान्कृच्छ्रं आचरेत् ।
पक्षसंख्याप्रमाणेन सुवर्णान्यपि दक्षिणा ॥ ४.१३ ॥
items.tr:
śuddhyarthaṃ aṣṭame caiva ṣaṇ māsānkṛcchraṃ ācaret |
pakṣasaṃkhyāpramāṇena suvarṇānyapi dakṣiṇā || 4.13 ||
items.en: … and in the eighth, to become pure, he should do Kṛcchra for six months. The dakṣiṇā is also gold pieces, as many as the number of the case.

items.text:
ऋतुस्नाता तु या नारी भर्तारं नोपसर्पति ।
सा मृता नरकं याति विधवा च पुनः पुनः ॥ ४.१४ ॥
items.tr:
ṛtusnātā tu yā nārī bhartāraṃ nopasarpati |
sā mṛtā narakaṃ yāti vidhavā ca punaḥ punaḥ || 4.14 ||
items.en: A woman who, after her bath at the end of her monthly period, does not go to her husband goes to hell when she dies and becomes a widow again and again.

items.text:
ऋतुस्नातां तु यो भार्यां संनिधौ नोपगच्छति ।
घोरायां भ्रूणहत्यायां युज्यते नात्र संशयः ॥ ४.१५ ॥
items.tr:
ṛtusnātāṃ tu yo bhāryāṃ saṃnidhau nopagacchati |
ghorāyāṃ bhrūṇahatyāyāṃ yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 4.15 ||
items.en: A man who is near his wife after her monthly bath and does not go to her is without doubt guilty of the terrible sin of killing an embryo.

items.text:
दरिद्रं व्याधितं मूर्खं भर्तारं यावमन्यते ।
सा शुनी जायते मृत्वा सूकरी च पुनः पुनः ॥ ४.१६ ॥
items.tr:
daridraṃ vyādhitaṃ mūrkhaṃ bhartāraṃ yāvamanyate |
sā śunī jāyate mṛtvā sūkarī ca punaḥ punaḥ || 4.16 ||
items.en: A woman who despises her husband because he is poor, sick or foolish is born as a bitch after death, and as a sow again and again.

items.text:
पत्यौ जीवति या नारी उपोष्य व्रतं आचरेत् ।
आयुष्यं हरते भर्तुः सा नारी नरकं व्रजेत् ॥ ४.१७ ॥
items.tr:
patyau jīvati yā nārī upoṣya vrataṃ ācaret |
āyuṣyaṃ harate bhartuḥ sā nārī narakaṃ vrajet || 4.17 ||
items.en: A woman who fasts and keeps vows while her husband is alive takes away her husband's life span; that woman goes to hell.

items.text:
अपृष्ट्वा चैव भर्तारं या नारी कुरुते व्रतम् ।
सर्वं तद्राक्षसान्गच्छेदित्येवं मनुरब्रवीत् ॥ ४.१८ ॥
items.tr:
apṛṣṭvā caiva bhartāraṃ yā nārī kurute vratam |
sarvaṃ tadrākṣasāngacchedityevaṃ manurabravīt || 4.18 ||
items.en: Whatever vow a woman keeps without asking her husband all goes to the demons; so said Manu.

items.text:
बान्धवानां सजातीनां दुर्वृत्तं कुरुते तु या ।
गर्भपातं च या कुर्यान्न तां संभाषयेत्क्वचित् ॥ ४.१९ ॥
items.tr:
bāndhavānāṃ sajātīnāṃ durvṛttaṃ kurute tu yā |
garbhapātaṃ ca yā kuryānna tāṃ saṃbhāṣayetkvacit || 4.19 ||
items.en: One should never speak with a woman who behaves badly among her relatives and caste-fellows, or who causes an abortion.

items.text:
यत्पापं ब्रह्महत्यायां द्विगुणं गर्भपातने ।
प्रायश्चित्तं न तस्याः स्यात्तस्यास्त्यागो विधीयते ॥ ४.२० ॥
items.tr:
yatpāpaṃ brahmahatyāyāṃ dviguṇaṃ garbhapātane |
prāyaścittaṃ na tasyāḥ syāttasyāstyāgo vidhīyate || 4.20 ||
items.en: The sin of causing an abortion is twice the sin of killing a brāhmaṇa. There is no expiation for her; she must be abandoned.

items.text:
न कार्यं आवसथ्येन नाग्निहोत्रेण वा पुनः ।
स भवेत्कर्मचाण्डालो यस्तु धर्मपराङ्मुखः ॥ ४.२१ ॥
items.tr:
na kāryaṃ āvasathyena nāgnihotreṇa vā punaḥ |
sa bhavetkarmacāṇḍālo yastu dharmaparāṅmukhaḥ || 4.21 ||
items.en: Nothing is gained by the household fire or by the agnihotra (for such a man); one who turns away from dharma becomes a caṇḍāla by his deeds.

items.text:
ओघवाताहृतं बीजं यस्य क्षेत्रे प्ररोहति ।
स क्षेत्री लभते बीजं न बीजी भागं अर्हति ॥ ४.२२ ॥
items.tr:
oghavātāhṛtaṃ bījaṃ yasya kṣetre prarohati |
sa kṣetrī labhate bījaṃ na bījī bhāgaṃ arhati || 4.22 ||
items.en: If seed carried by a flood or the wind sprouts in someone's field, the owner of the field gets the crop; the owner of the seed gets no share.

items.text:
तद्वत्परस्त्रियाः पुत्रौ द्वौ स्मृतौ कुण्डगोलकौ ।
पत्यौ जीवति कुण्डः स्यात्मृते भर्तरि गोलकः ॥ ४.२३ ॥
items.tr:
tadvatparastriyāḥ putrau dvau smṛtau kuṇḍagolakau |
patyau jīvati kuṇḍaḥ syātmṛte bhartari golakaḥ || 4.23 ||
items.en: In the same way, two kinds of sons born to another man's wife are called kuṇḍa and golaka: a kuṇḍa is born while the husband is alive, a golaka after the husband has died.

items.text:
औरसः क्षेत्रजश्चैव दत्तः कृत्रिमकः सुतः ।
दद्यान्माता पिता वापि स पुत्रो दत्तको भवेत् ॥ ४.२४ ॥
items.tr:
aurasaḥ kṣetrajaścaiva dattaḥ kṛtrimakaḥ sutaḥ |
dadyānmātā pitā vāpi sa putro dattako bhavet || 4.24 ||
items.en: (The sons are) the aurasa, the kṣetraja, the datta and the kṛtrima. The son whom the mother or the father gives away becomes a dattaka (adopted son).
items.note: aurasa: son born of one's own wife. kṣetraja: son born of one's wife by another man. datta / dattaka: son given in adoption. kṛtrima: a son 'made' by one's choice.

items.text:
परिवित्तिः परिवेत्ता यया च परिविद्यते ।
सर्वे ते नरकं यान्ति दातृयाजकपञ्चमाः ॥ ४.२५ ॥
items.tr:
parivittiḥ parivettā yayā ca parividyate |
sarve te narakaṃ yānti dātṛyājakapañcamāḥ || 4.25 ||
items.en: The elder brother passed over, the younger brother who marries before him, the girl he marries, the one who gives her, and the priest as the fifth: all of them go to hell.
items.note: This concerns a younger brother marrying before his unmarried elder brother (parivedana).

items.text:
द्वौ कृच्छ्रौ परिवित्तेस्तु कन्यायाः कृच्छ्र एव च ।
कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रौ दातुस्तु होता चान्द्रायणं चरेत् ॥ ४.२६ ॥
items.tr:
dvau kṛcchrau parivittestu kanyāyāḥ kṛcchra eva ca |
kṛcchrātikṛcchrau dātustu hotā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret || 4.26 ||
items.en: The elder brother passed over must do two Kṛcchras; the girl, one Kṛcchra; the giver, a Kṛcchra and an Atikṛcchra; and the officiating priest must do the Cāndrāyaṇa.
items.note: Atikṛcchra: a harder form of the Kṛcchra, eating only one mouthful at each permitted meal.

items.text:
कुब्जवामनषण्ढेषु गद्गदेषु जडेषु च ।
जात्यन्धे बधिरे मूके न दोषः परिवेदने ॥ ४.२७ ॥
items.tr:
kubjavāmanaṣaṇḍheṣu gadgadeṣu jaḍeṣu ca |
jātyandhe badhire mūke na doṣaḥ parivedane || 4.27 ||
items.en: There is no fault in marrying before an elder brother who is hunchbacked, a dwarf, impotent, a stammerer, dull-witted, blind from birth, deaf or mute.

items.text:
पितृव्यपुत्रः सापत्नः परनारीसुतस्तथा ।
दाराग्निहोत्रसम्योगे न दोषः परिवेदने ॥ ४.२८ ॥
items.tr:
pitṛvyaputraḥ sāpatnaḥ paranārīsutastathā |
dārāgnihotrasamyoge na doṣaḥ parivedane || 4.28 ||
items.en: If the elder is a paternal uncle's son, a half-brother from a co-wife, or a son of another man's wife, there is no fault in marrying or setting up the sacred fire before him.

items.text:
ज्येष्ठो भ्राता यदा तिष्ठेदाधानं नैव कारयेत् ।
अनुज्ञातस्तु कुर्वीत शङ्खस्य वचनं यथा ॥ ४.२९ ॥
items.tr:
jyeṣṭho bhrātā yadā tiṣṭhedādhānaṃ naiva kārayet |
anujñātastu kurvīta śaṅkhasya vacanaṃ yathā || 4.29 ||
items.en: While the elder brother has not yet set up the sacred fires, the younger should not set them up; but with his permission he may do so, as Śaṅkha says.

items.text:
नष्टे मृते प्रव्रजिते क्लीबे च पतिते पतौ ।
पञ्चस्वापत्सु नारीणां पतिरन्यो विधीयते ॥ ४.३० ॥
items.tr:
naṣṭe mṛte pravrajite klībe ca patite patau |
pañcasvāpatsu nārīṇāṃ patiranyo vidhīyate || 4.30 ||
items.en: If the husband is missing, dead, has become an ascetic, is impotent, or has fallen from caste: in these five calamities another husband is allowed for women.

items.text:
मृते भर्तरि या नारी ब्रह्मचर्यव्रते स्थिता ।
सा मृता लभते स्वर्गं यथा ते ब्रह्मचारिणः ॥ ४.३१ ॥
items.tr:
mṛte bhartari yā nārī brahmacaryavrate sthitā |
sā mṛtā labhate svargaṃ yathā te brahmacāriṇaḥ || 4.31 ||
items.en: A woman who, after her husband dies, keeps a vow of chastity goes to heaven when she dies, like those lifelong brahmacārīs.

items.text:
तिस्रः कोट्योऽर्धकोटी च यानि रोमाणि मानुषे ।
तावत्कालं वसेत्स्वर्गे भर्तारं यानुगच्छति ॥ ४.३२ ॥
items.tr:
tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭī ca yāni romāṇi mānuṣe |
tāvatkālaṃ vasetsvarge bhartāraṃ yānugacchati || 4.32 ||
items.en: A woman who follows her husband (in death) lives in heaven for as many years as there are hairs on the human body, three and a half crore.
items.note: crore: ten million. 'Follows her husband' means dying on his funeral pyre (sati).

items.text:
व्यालग्राही यथा व्यालं बलादुद्धरते बिलात् ।
एवं स्त्री पतिं उद्धृत्य तेनैव सह मोदते ॥ ४.३३ ॥
items.tr:
vyālagrāhī yathā vyālaṃ balāduddharate bilāt |
evaṃ strī patiṃ uddhṛtya tenaiva saha modate || 4.33 ||
items.en: Just as a snake-catcher pulls a snake out of its hole by force, so a woman lifts her husband up (from hell) and rejoices with him.
